findings: VERIFIED: Identity bindings are sound end to end — session() pins app/installation/repository/bot/operator IDs with strict permission equality and re-verifies repo scope with the issued token; Outbox binds the issue-creation response to bot_id, exact body, and repository; acknowledge binds comment id, operator id, exact issue URL, byte-exact ACK body, and unedited state (created_at==updated_at).

VERIFIED: Replies never become operating authority — the broker exposes no acknowledge route (ACK consumption is operator-CLI only), send/acknowledge return operational_authority:False, notify_task_block's [A-Z0-9_]{1,80} reason regex blocks free-text injection, and broker errors reduce to named codes with no request echo.

VERIFIED: No-repost/fail-closed recovery holds — UNCERTAIN persists under BEGIN IMMEDIATE before the network POST, UNCERTAIN refuses repost, Notices caps at three attempts into a durable BLOCKED row, and notification failure neither halts nor refunds admissions; model staging orders receipt/started/predecessor checks before admission and model invocation.

SUGGESTION (handover_notifications._send): the bare `except Exception` records config errors, identity drift, scan refusals, and UNCERTAIN reconciles as indistinguishable RETRY/BLOCKED rows; add a bounded named-code reason column so the durable block explains what happened, per the charter's error-explanation requirement.

SUGGESTION (handover_notifications._send): a crash between the PENDING insert and the status update leaves a terminal row reported forever as PENDING with attempts>=3 instead of BLOCKED; normalize the status on read or at insert.

SUGGESTION (tests): repeated-delivery correctness depends on immutable() (operations_report, not supplied) tolerating identical-content rewrites of verified-identities.json; the supplied tests exercise only one distinct key and would still pass if every delivery after the first failed — add a test delivering two distinct keys successfully.

SUGGESTION (protected_handover.notify_report): dedup key is report+phase but the summary embeds the caller-chosen source pin, so re-notifying the same report from a different containing commit raises NOTICE_IDENTITY_CHANGED instead of returning a duplicate; derive the summary from the dedup key or include source in the key.

SUGGESTION (rate bounding): no aggregate cap exists on distinct notification keys — each new 64-hex task or report hash opens a new GitHub issue with only per-key attempt caps; consider a daily issue-creation ceiling in Notices to bound a misbehaving controller loop.

OBSERVATION: flush_notifications never records successful delivery back into ledger state; idempotence rests entirely on Notices dedup and pending_notifications (dispatch_limiter, outside supplied source) — confirm its pending set is bounded and clearable.

OBSERVATION: acknowledge re-runs packet_checked, so the ACK window closes at packet expiry (24h); late ACKs fail with PACKET_EXPIRY rather than an explanatory code — document or rename if intentional.

OBSERVATION: GITHUB_BOUNDARY_AUDIT_20260907 honestly records absent main-branch protection and repo-credential bypass of the application route, correctly deferring remediation to the pre-live-grant operator packet, consistent with the charter's separate gates.

investigator_disposition.durable_error_and_terminal_status: Accepted bounded correction before live notification configuration.
investigator_disposition.two_distinct_notices: Add regression test; immutable() already accepts identical bytes.
investigator_disposition.report_source_dedup: The current runtime passes the one recorded publication pin; a different pin remains a named conflict, not an automatic duplicate or new issue.
investigator_disposition.notification_global_rate: No new standing notification cadence is activated. Final permission packet must disclose per-key caps and bound configuration before activation.
investigator_disposition.pending_set: dispatch_limiter.pending_notifications returns at most the four latest persisted threshold identities; protected Notices deduplicates successful sends without mutating the admission ledger.
investigator_disposition.late_ack: 24-hour acknowledgment expiry is intentional; operational decisions remain disabled.
